lead: This week in tech: OpenAI restructures, Stripe acquires an AI startup, and deepfake scams rise in Australia.
themes: Novel use cases and applications of technology

stories.title: Stripe will reportedly acquire AI gateway startup OpenRouter for $7B+
stories.summary: Stripe is set to acquire OpenRouter, a startup that positions itself as 'Stripe for AI,' for over $7 billion. This acquisition highlights the growing intersection of payment processing and artificial intelligence, as OpenRouter aims to simplify the integration of AI capabilities into various applications. The deal reflects Stripe's commitment to expanding its offerings in the tech landscape.

stories.title: OpenAI reportedly disbanded its preparedness team
stories.summary: OpenAI has reportedly disbanded its preparedness team, which was responsible for assessing risks associated with AI models. The responsibilities have been redistributed among existing teams, signaling a shift in the company's internal structure as it prepares for a potential IPO. This change comes amid ongoing scrutiny of AI's safety and ethical implications.

stories.title: Deepfake Anthony Albanese used in celebrity scams duping Australians out of $7.4m, ASIC warns
stories.summary: Australia's corporate watchdog has reported a surge in scams using deepfake technology, with Prime Minister Anthony Albanese being the most commonly impersonated figure. These scams have defrauded Australians out of approximately $7.4 million, highlighting the urgent need for public awareness and regulatory measures against such fraudulent activities.

stories.title: Anthropic CEO says AI backlash is ‘fundamentally a crisis of trust’
stories.summary: Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic, has addressed the growing backlash against AI technologies, characterizing it as a crisis of trust. He emphasizes that AI companies must deliver genuine breakthroughs to regain public confidence. This statement comes as the industry faces increasing skepticism about its promises and capabilities.

stories.title: OpenAI’s new ChatGPT feature logs your keystrokes and stores them in plain text
stories.summary: OpenAI has introduced a new feature called Computer History in ChatGPT, which records user actions on macOS to enhance the AI's learning capabilities. This feature, however, raises privacy concerns as it stores data in unencrypted plain text. Users can opt-in and manage what data is recorded, but the implications for user privacy are significant.

stories.title: Anglicare transforms its IT service management
stories.summary: Anglicare has revamped its IT service management by deploying a new stack focused on monitoring and observability. This transformation aims to improve operational efficiency and service delivery within the organization. Such upgrades are critical for non-profits to enhance their technological capabilities.

stories.title: Why people aren’t buying Mark Zuckerberg’s AI future
stories.summary: In a recent podcast, experts discussed the skepticism surrounding Mark Zuckerberg's vision for AI, highlighting public concerns about privacy and the ethical use of technology. The conversation reflects broader anxieties about the direction of AI development and its implications for society, particularly in light of recent controversies.

stories.title: US to tell partners they must pick sides in AI race with China
stories.summary: The US government is preparing to urge its allies to take a definitive stance in the ongoing AI competition with China. This move is part of a broader strategy to solidify partnerships and ensure that democratic nations align in their approach to AI development and governance, amidst rising global tensions.

stories.title: The Pixel's new 'HiLight' reminds me of the golden days of Android phones
stories.summary: Google's Pixel 11 Pro has introduced a new feature called 'HiLight,' which pays homage to classic notification LEDs. This nostalgic addition aims to enhance user experience by providing a subtle yet effective way to stay informed about notifications, blending modern technology with a touch of retro charm.
